features: Direct Keystroke Typing Engine: Completely eliminated clipboard reliance and KEYCODE_PASTE for password entry, preventing stale clipboard data from ever pasting into Instagram
Password Verification & Soft Keyboard Handling: Replaced KEYCODE_ESCAPE with KEYCODE_BACK and IME ENTER (keycode 66), ensuring text is never cleared and preventing 'password cannot be empty' errors
Accurate Next Button Geometry: Fixed Next button coordinate fallback on password screen to hit the real button below fields and checkboxes
Pre-fetching pipeline: extracts and verifies all credentials from EasyEarn FIRST before feeding to Instagram
Smart Birthday wheel automation: auto-scrolls Year backwards ~20-25 years and confirms DatePicker dialogs
Clean input field wiping: fixed backspace logic to prevent typing stray characters like 'a'
